sysd-q-015.caption: Follow an account from the client to the queue, the extraction service and the stores it fills.
sysd-q-015.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Client] --> B[Reverse proxy]
B --> C[Accounts API server]
C --> D[(SQL accounts table)]
C -->|queues a job| E[Queue]
E --> F[Transaction Extraction Service]
F --> G[(Object store: raw logs)]
F --> H[Category Service]
F --> I[Budget Service]
I --> J[Notification Service]
F --> K[(SQL transactions)]

sysd-q-066.caption: Each stage removes the bottleneck of the one before it.
sysd-q-066.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Monolith on one server] -->|user base grows| B[Application and database servers split]
B -->|one application server not enough| C[Cluster behind a load balancer]
C -->|database bottleneck| D[Read replicas serve reads]
D -->|one database cannot carry all| E[Partition or add a cache]
E --> F[Separate services]

sysd-q-130.caption: Read the steps of one transaction from top to bottom.
rows: Message lines, then a lone period

sysd-q-137.caption: Each group of header fields has its own job.
rows: Names a message and its parent
Added when a message is reintroduced

sysd-q-121.caption: POP and IMAP differ on where the mailbox lives.
rows: Downloaded to one device, then deleted
Stay on the server, shared by clients

sysd-q-058.caption: Mail is pushed by SMTP between servers and pulled by Bob's client.
sysd-q-058.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Alice's client] -->|submits by SMTP| B[Alice's mail server]
B -->|asks for MX records| C[DNS]
B -->|SMTP, port 25| D[Gmail SMTP server]
D --> E[Delivery agent]
E --> F[(Recipient's mailbox)]
F -->|IMAP or POP| G[Bob's client]

sysd-q-060.caption: The client reaches three services: location, a CDN for tiles, and navigation.
sysd-q-060.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Client] -->|location updates| B[Location service]
A -->|tile requests| C[CDN]
C --> D[(Cloud storage)]
A -->|route request| E[Navigation service]
E --> F[Geocoding Service]
E --> G[Route Planner Service]

sysd-q-027.caption: An order crosses the critical path in order, and the execution leaves through the order manager.
sysd-q-027.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Client] -->|order| B[Order manager]
B --> C[Mandatory risk checks]
C --> D[Matching engine]
D -->|matched| E[Order manager sends execution out]

sysd-q-059.caption: Editing operations pass through a queue before the file operation server transforms them.
sysd-q-059.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Clients] -->|editing operations| B[WebSocket server]
B --> C[Message queue]
C --> D[File operation server]
D --> E[(Metadata, content, operations)]
